s.t:
Was haben ein Top-Mountainbike, ein künstliches Hüftgelenk und ein Smartphone gemeinsam? Wir entwickeln die Software, um diese High-End-Produkte herzustellen! Mit hyperMILL® steuern wir CNC-Maschinen und haben höchste Ansprüche an Leistung und Teilequalität.
Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Entwickler von leistungsstarken CAD/CAM-Lösungen – und das seit mehr als 30 Jahren! Unsere innovativen CAD/CAM-Technologien sorgen für eine deutlich höhere Performance im Programmierprozess und setzen internationale Maßstäbe in der zerspanenden Fertigung.
Für unser Produktmanagement suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen erfahrenen Produktmanager (m/w/d) mit starkem Verständnis für zerspanende Prozesse und der 2.5D, 3-Achs und 5-Achs-Bearbeitung.
Ihre Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte
Identifikation, Priorisierung und Validierung von Kundenanforderungen, Marktpotenzialen und technologischen Chancen im Bereich 2.5D-, 3-Achs- und 5-Achs-Bearbeitung
Begleitung der Produktentwicklung von der Problemdefinition und Discovery über die Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung neuer Funktionen und Lösungen
Bewertung von Anforderungen hinsichtlich Kundennutzen, technischer Machbarkeit und strategischer Relevanz sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der Produktstrategie
Absicherung neuer Konzepte und Lösungen durch Kundenfeedback, Praxistests sowie strukturierte Risikoanalysen
Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung, QA, Anwendungstechnik, Support, Marketing und Vertrieb zur Sicherstellung einer konsistenten und erfolgreichen Produktentwicklung

Sicherstellung der konsistenten Integration neuer Funktionen in Bezug auf User Experience, Produktstrategie und hyperMILL-Gesamtkonzept sowie Verantwortung für die Erreichung definierter Produktziele und die nachhaltige Verbesserung des Kundennutzens
Ihr Profil
Tiefgreifendes Wissen in der Zerspanung sowie fundiertes Verständnis von CAM-Prozessen, CNC-Maschinen, Steuerungen, Werkzeugen und Fertigungsabläufen
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im CAM-, Zerspanungs- oder Produktmanagementumfeld sowie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Validierung und Markteinführung technischer Produktlösungen
Souveräne Bewertung von Anforderungen, Risiken und Prioritäten sowie Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Aufbereitung komplexer technischer Sachverhalte
Sicheres Agieren im Austausch mit Kunden sowie interdisziplinären Teams und Stakeholdern

Du möchtest innovative KI- und Automatisierungslösungen für den Kundenservice verantworten und ihre Weiterentwicklung aktiv gestalten? Wir suchen Menschen mit Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise im Customer-Service- oder Contact-Center-Umfeld. Verstärke unser Team am Standort Hamburg oder Leipzig zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Product Owner Agent Assist & User Platforms (m/w/d).
Das bieten wir
Sicherer Arbeitsplatz : Arbeite Vollzeit in einem unbefristeten Arbeitsverhältnis in einem krisensicheren, wachstumsorientierten Umfeld
Hybrides Arbeiten: Nutze die Möglichkeit, flexibel von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten, als Teil unserer modernen Arbeitswelt
Team- und Firmenevents: Nimm regelmäßig an spannenden Events teil und fördere den Teamgeist
Corporate Benefits : Erhalte Mitarbeitervergünstigungen für Reisen, Bildung, Technik, Mobilfunk und Lifestyle mit bis zu 75 % Rabatt
HRS-Konditionen für private Reisen: Nutze als Mitarbeiter:in der Ströer X die verhandelten Ströer Rahmenkonditionen mit HRS Hotels auch privat
Jobbike: Profitiere von unserem digitalen Dienstrad-Programm
Deine Aufgaben
Verantworte die Produktvision, Roadmap und Weiterentwicklung unserer Agent-Assist- und Automatisierungsplattformen entlang der Unternehmensstrategie
Priorisiere das Product Backlog, definiere Anforderungen und steuere die Umsetzung neuer Funktionen gemeinsam mit dem agilen Entwicklungsteam
Entwickle innovative KI-gestützte Agent-Assist-Funktionen für Telefonie, Chat und E-Mail – von Echtzeit-Empfehlungen über automatisierte Zusammenfassungen bis zur Integration von Wissensdatenbanken
Arbeite eng mit Operations, Data Science, IT-Entwicklung sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen und begleite die Einführung neuer Lösungen bis in den operativen Einsatz
Fördere die Nutzerakzeptanz unserer Produkte, leite Optimierungspotenziale aus KPIs und Nutzerfeedback ab und stelle einen nachhaltigen Business-Impact sicher
Präsentiere Produktfortschritte, moderiere Workshops und bereite Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Management und Stakeholder auf
Stelle die Einhaltung von Datenschutz-, Compliance- und Informationssicherheitsanforderungen bei der Weiterentwicklung und Integration neuer KI-Lösungen sicher
So bist Du
abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise im Contact-Center-, BPO- oder Customer-Service-Umfeld
fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung und Integration von IT-Lösungen, insbesondere im Bereich Contact-Center-Technologien, Voice Services und Cloud-Plattformen
Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung technischer Systemlandschaften sowie moderner Integrationslösungen
praktische Erfahrung im operativen Betrieb von Contact-Center-Prozessen und IT-Infrastrukturen
Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen (z. B. Scrum oder Kanban) sowie gängigen Tools wie Jira oder Confluence
Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern im verhandlungssicheren Deutsch und Englisch
Wenn dich diese interessante Aufgabe anspricht und mit deinem fachlichen und persönlichen Profil übereinstimmt, dann sende uns deine aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung, sowie deines möglichen Eintrittstermins .
Bei Fragen steht dir René Bach unter der Telefonnummer +49 172 846 2645 zur Verfügung. Wir freuen uns auf dich!
Sämtliche Bezeichnungen richten sich an alle Geschlechter.

Are you a seasoned product manager looking to build experiences that millions of people rely on to discover new ways to make a living with Uber? Are you energized by creating user journeys where magical experiences, growth, and trust must work hand in hand? If so, this role might be for you.
As a Lead Product Manager your impact on the business side, onboarding, and making new drivers successful is the lifeblood that powers Uber's growth and creates a path to economic empowerment for millions of people every year.
In this role, you will envision and deliver a multi-gig experience that is intuitive, fast, globally scalable and tailored to different earner segments. You will own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for how drivers and couriers discover new earning opportunities, maximize their earnings and manage their platform access across all of their gigs.
This role requires strong product sense, a good understanding of the driver persona and their motivations and great crossfunctional agility. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, operations, legal, and trust & safety partners to build experiences that support and scale with the speed of our business.

The Earner growth team sits at the heart of the earner lifecycle and plays a foundational role in Uber's global growth. We are responsible for maximizing the number of quality, high performing earners on the platform.

We achieve this through optimizing the onboarding experience, enabling earners to progress during their early lifecycle and by helping to maximize their earning potential through multiple gigs to increase retention. In the event that earners churn, we also focus on bringing them back to the platform.

Own the product roadmap and lead vision, definition and execution for building Uber's earner multi gig experience.
Rethink the journey - deeply understand earners, their motivations and challenges and keep making the gig discovery and recommendation experience better.
Innovate - find new ways of simplifying the user experience with new technologies.
Distill vision and strategy for the team, get all members of cross-functional team #superpumped.
Own your numbers, drive your cross-functional team of engineers, data scientist, product ops and designers to set qualitative objectives and quantitative goals -- and overachieve them.
Clearly communicate product plans, benefits, and results to leadership.

Minimum of 6 years of product management experience.
Experience delivering highly successful and creative consumer Internet products with your fingerprints all over them - you're proud of what you've accomplished.
Data-driven: you always get the data you need, and you can distill it into an insightful story. Most importantly, you leverage data to drive strategic decisions.
Technical skills. Ability to inform and evaluate engineering decisions.

Any experience working with gig economy earners
Launching products in different international markets
Experience in building and optimizing complex user acquisition funnels or recommendation engines

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $216,000 per year - USD $240,000 per year.
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

About Remote Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams.

With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remote rs working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! What this job can offer you This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Product Manager , joining our Product team in the Fintech vertical .

As a Billing Platform Product Manager, you will be a key member of our triad of product managers in the billing team, each leading their independent teams yet working within an interconnected scope. As a Product Manager at Remote , you'll be developing and guiding our strategy for a key product area in Finance.

You'll advance this vision by working with a cross-functional engineering and design group to find our most important problems and shape iterative solutions towards them. What you bring Prior experience as product manager in billing / invoicing or similar, ideally at a high-growth company Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code or similar tool.

You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional prototypes or small code changes with the help of AI tooling, not just write specs.

Great judgment making both strategic (what to prioritize) and tactical (feature scope) decisions Demonstrable, self-driven results that have moved a product in the right direction A passion for creating seamless and effective products, even when the challenges they address are complex and intricate.

Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, including across different departments (e.g. business operations, sales, etc.) to ensure that we’re satisfying critical business requirements Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Bonus: Experience working in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities Build solutions together with the rest of the team that solve for finance, billing and other financial services at Remote Own not just software implementation, but the end-to-end experience: Remote delivers value through services powered by both humans and software Lead on complex solutions without requiring support or involvement from senior members of the product team Effectively manage internal expectations for complex projects, products, and features while navigating challenging prioritization decisions Drive Remote in the right direction by building an effective roadmap and strategy for your area of the product in Finance Break down strategic plans into near and mid-term goals that's easy for others to understand Align your product roadmap with higher level department and company problems we’re working to solve Be the subject matter expert for your product area Contribute to scaling and growth plans for your product area Ship improvements quickly and iteratively, challenging yourself and counterparts to find minimal solutions to problems Support and leads a product team delivering high throughput and high return on investment Understand key business KPIs and align your team's work and metrics to directly improve to these Work together with engineers, designers and stakeholders to build solutions to important complex problems Communicate and collaborate internally and externally Contribute to the Product org by sharing your techniques, processes, and learnings Communicate and promote the work of your team and why it matters to customers and internal teams Work asynchronously and transparently Lead on solutions with minimal support or involvement from senior members of the product team.

You should be able to work autonomously on simple features and iterations, only needing support to solve complex problems Contribute to tactical and strategic decision-making for your business area Develop into a subject matter expert for understanding, articulating, and solving complex business problems related to our mobile experiences Practicals You'll report to: Group Product Manager Location : For this position we welcome everyone to apply Start date: As soon as possible Remote Compensation Philosophy Remote 's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate.

We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries. At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context.

At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally. The base salary range for this full-time position is $62,400 to $140,400.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands.

The base salary range may be subject to change. At Remote , we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness.

Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

We are looking for a Associate Product Delivery Manager to help turn product priorities into clear, well-organized work for our engineering and design teams.
Working closely with our Product Lead, you will help define new features, prepare upcoming work, coordinate requirements, and keep track of sprint progress. You will bring structure and clarity to the product-development process while growing your product-management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship.
This is a good opportunity for someone early in their product career who is organized, curious, and comfortable collaborating across different disciplines.
Tasks
Draft feature scopes, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the Product Lead.
Help maintain and organize the product backlog.
Prepare features and tasks for refinement and sprint planning.
Coordinate requirements and open questions between product, engineering, and design.
Track sprint status, delivery progress, dependencies, and blockers.
Keep the team and relevant stakeholders informed about progress and changes.
Support planning, refinement, reviews, and other product-delivery meetings.

s.h: Document product requirements, decisions, and changes.
s.t:
Gather the information needed for prioritization discussions.
Contribute recommendations while the Product Lead retains final prioritization responsibility.
Help improve the team’s product-development and delivery processes.
Take on greater product ownership as your skills and experience develop.

Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in product management, project coordination, business analysis, software delivery, design, QA, or a related area. Relevant internships and working-student experience may count.
Some experience working with software engineering, design, or other multidisciplinary teams.
The ability to turn discussions and ideas into clear written requirements and action items.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Clear and thoughtful written and verbal communication.
Confidence following up on open questions, dependencies, and commitments.
Curiosity about users, technology, and how digital products are built.
A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn.
Basic familiarity with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Linear, Notion, or Confluence.
Helpful, but not required
Experience writing user stories or acceptance criteria.
Familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, or software-release processes.
Enough technical curiosity to learn about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or another quickly changing environment.
You do not need to meet every item on this list. We care about your potential, judgment, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

s.h: What success looks like within your first six months
s.t:
Upcoming features and tasks are documented clearly and prepared on time.
Sprint progress, dependencies, and blockers are visible to the team.
Product decisions and requirement changes are consistently documented.
Engineering and design know where to find the information they need.
Open questions are identified and brought to the right people early.
The Product Lead has reliable support across planning, prioritization, and delivery.
You begin handling smaller features with increasing independence.

We offer an exciting environment at the interface between IT and entertainment and marketing as part of an ambitious, international and results-orientated team in a young startup.
You work with an excellent international team with varied tasks with a wide range of great opportunities

Monthly learning budget
Urban Sports Club membership support
Support for your favourite means of transport - we help finance your new bike or your public transport subscription
We are a startup in one of the cultural hubs in Berlin, you'll never get bored
We welcome applicants with different backgrounds and experiences. If the role interests you but you do not meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

Grafana Labs is a remote-first, open-source powerhouse. There are more than 20M users of Grafana, the open source visualization tool, around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps.

The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a NASA launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France.

Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Ireland. About Product Management: As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs , you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain.

You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders.

The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential. Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM.

You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers. The opportunity:
As the Senior Product Manager for Infrastructure Observability (Infra O11y) you’ll be responsible for our most popular Grafana Cloud products that span the infrastructure suite: Kubernetes Monitoring and Cloud Provider Observability. Infra O11y provides our customers with the ability to easily monitor their core services – from our smallest self-serve customers to our largest enterprise customers.
Your primary responsibility will be to help define the vision and ensure the long-term success of Infra O11y, working with your engineering partners to fine-tune product strategy. You will be charting the path forward for net-new product initiatives – like Host Monitoring – balanced with maintaining a strong roadmap and customer satisfaction for our most mature products.
Your role will require heavy customer discovery, understanding user needs, and building consensus and alignment across several Engineering groups and many stakeholders as we look towards simplifying our broader Infra O11y experience for Grafana Cloud. You will also need to flex your GTM muscles and build conviction in areas like competitive analysis and sales enablement to better inform activities like pricing and packaging.
Beyond driving your individual product area, you’ll also need to ensure that the experiences you’re building are tightly woven into our overall Grafana Cloud suite of products, by establishing integration touchpoints with other key offerings like Grafana Cloud Knowledge Graph and Grafana Assistant, so that our customers have a seamless monitoring experience where they can easily navigate between different layers of their architecture through guided explorations and natural language.

Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

s.h: What makes you a great fit
s.t:
A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
7+ years of experience in Product Management
5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product
Experience using or building developer-facing tools, APIs, or platform services
Ability to discuss APIs, data models, schema evolution, and distributed systems concepts
Experience driving adoption of shared services or platform capabilities across multiple product teams
Experience working with Engineering and Design teams build delightful products and features – with sounds UX – in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies
Experience using or building observability products and/or developer tools, either internally as an SRE or for external customers
Proficient with infrastructure concepts and components – like Kubernetes, Cloud Service Providers, and VMs – and able to articulate these models in human-readable terms
Experience with AI tools

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs ' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager – Agent Experience to join the LivePerson Product team and lead the strategy and execution for our Agent and Manager Workspace . As the Senior Product Manager for Agent Experience , you will define the vision for agent productivity, AI-assisted workflows, and extensible platform capabilities that power modern customer service operations. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering, UX Design, AI/ML, Infrastructure, Customer Success, Sales, and Solution Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and intuitive agent experiences.
Agent Productivity & Experience: Champion user-centered design principles to simplify complex workflows, reduce agent effort, improve task completion, and enable faster, higher-quality customer conversations.

Market Analysis: Continuously monitor industry trends in customer service platforms, contact center technology, AI copilots, workforce productivity, conversational interfaces, and competitive offerings to inform product strategy.

___________________________________________________________________________ DEXIOS ist unsere Cloud-Plattform für Zutrittskontrolle, Zutrittsmanagement und Zeiterfassung. Die Software ist live, sie ist noch jung, und sie steht jetzt an dem Punkt, an dem aus einem funktionierenden Produkt eine skalierbare SaaS-Lösung wird.
Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für diesen Weg: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird, in welcher Reihenfolge und warum. Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!
Deine Aufgaben PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung
Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik
Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten
Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt
Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
TEAM – Schnittstellen
Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen
PROFIL – Dein Kompetenzset
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder technischer Produktmanager (m/w/d) für ein Softwareprodukt, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit echtem Ownership – du hast das Software- oder SaaS-Produkt verantwortet und durch relevante Reifephasen geführt.
Cloud- und SaaS-Architekturen, APIs und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut: Du liest eine Schnittstellenbeschreibung, ohne dass jemand sie dir erklärt
KI ist Teil deiner Arbeitsweise, nicht ein Punkt auf deiner Skill-Liste. Du kannst konkret erzählen, wofür du sie zuletzt eingesetzt hast, und auch, wann sie dich falsch beraten hat
Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und hast ein Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit (ISO 27001)
Was diese Rolle nicht ist
Kein Ticket-Schreiben nach fremder Vorgabe. Die Roadmap kommt von dir
Keine reine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien. Du arbeitest im Sprint mit
Kein Scrum-Master-Job. Prozesspflege ist nicht der Kern
Kein fertiges Produkt mit fertigen Prozessen. Vieles bauen wir gerade erst auf, das ist Freiheit und Arbeit zugleich

About Netholabs
Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.

We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.
You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.

Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation
Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirements — and push back when a requirement doesn't survive contact with manufacturing
Build the quality, documentation, and regulatory groundwork (design history, ISO 13485-style discipline, CE/UKCA pathway) appropriate to a research-device product

Hypofriend is a next-generation online mortgage advisor using proprietary technology to find customers the best mortgage possible and give holistic financial advice.
Unlike other mortgage advisors or brokers, we use financial insights to guide our customers. By joining us, you will be able to tap into these insights and be part of our path to transform the industry. We provide customers with tools that help them navigate the entire home buying process, from making buying decisions and give advice on the next steps to build wealth in Germany.
As Product Manager you own a slice of that machine end-to-end: the internal platform our advisors and operations team run on, and the AI and automation that make the mortgage process faster and less manual. You will work closely with engineering, design, advisors, and the founders.
Tasks
Own your product area end-to-end — from problem discovery and prioritisation to spec, launch, and measurement.
Build for our advisors and ops team. Improve the CRM, advisory and application workflows, document handling, and lender submission so advisors spend their time advising, not administrating.
Ship AI and automation into the mortgage journey — document extraction and verification, AI-assisted advisory prep, decision support, and agentic workflows — with clear guardrails for accuracy and compliance.
Connect the dots across the funnel. Understand how the customer-facing product, advisor tooling, and lender/partner integrations affect each other, and make trade-offs across them.
Learn the business deeply enough to find the levers. Understand our advice and sales principles, how the market works, and how advisors, banks and agents actually move a case forward. Use that to spot where the business loses value — drop-offs, rework, waiting time — and where a product change unblocks it. A roadmap here is a set of bets on levers, not a wish list of features.
Define success with numbers. Set metrics per initiative (conversion, time-to-offer, advisor capacity per case, automation rate, error rate), instrument them, and report honestly on outcomes.
Write clear specs and keep delivery moving. Groom the backlog, run rituals, unblock engineers, and make the call when scope has to be cut.
Work within a regulated domain. Partner with compliance and our lending partners so what we ship holds up under German mortgage regulation.

2–4 years in product management, ideally on a product with real operational complexity (fintech, marketplace, internal tooling, or workflow automation).
Comfort with numbers and data — you can write your own SQL queries or analyses rather than waiting for someone else.
A practical grasp of what today's AI models can and cannot be trusted with, and how to design around that.
A solid UX foundation — you understand how interface and interaction design shape behaviour, and you can design flows that guide advisors and the CSM team towards the right action instead of just exposing more fields and buttons.
Strong written communication and the ability to make complex financial mechanics feel simple.
Structured, self-directed, and comfortable in a small team where you own the outcome, not just the ticket.
Fluent English. German is a strong plus (our lenders, contracts, and regulation are German).
Interest in mortgages, real estate, or personal finance — the domain rewards people who go deep.

Experience with process automation, document AI, or LLM-based product features in production.
Background in lending, insurance, or another regulated financial product.
Some technical fluency — you can read an API contract and discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers.

Take initiative by default. When something is unclear or broken, you go and find out, rather than waiting for a decision to arrive.

Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration

Drive execution with clear specs, strong judgment, and disciplined prioritization
Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops
Own product quality end-to-end - correctness, predictability, and user trust

Technical foundation

Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and how modern AI systems behave in production.
Comfort reading, reviewing, and discussing technical design documents.
AI & ML experience

Experience working with model evaluation, prompt or pipeline iteration, and feedback loops.

Product leadership

AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.
Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for super premium, closely held business owners.
We are re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs. From the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, financial operations, all rebuilt from the ground up as a single intelligent system.
Since launching publicly in September 2023, we have scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue. The backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. We are replacing the outdated banks and fragmented tools they are stuck with. The opportunity is a roughly $1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. We are building toward $100B+ in enterprise value by delivering a product that is fundamentally better, not incrementally improved.
Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.
What we hold ourselves to: mission-critical problems, high bar low ego, speed over comfort, enduring impact.
Locations: Remote. Open to candidates in Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Colombia.

--------
You will own Flex's Accountants Stack. Accounting integrations, expense management, bill pay, invoicing, AR and AP, and financial reporting. The full set of tools that closely held business owners and the accountants who serve them use to run the financial operations of the company.
The accountant is the lead persona for this role. Bookkeepers, controllers, fractional CFOs, and outside CPAs are the people who actually live in this software day to day. Build for them and the owner wins by default. Build only for the owner and the accountant works around you, which means you lose.
The reason this role exists at Flex and not at every fintech is the unique customer we serve.

Super premium business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue have a controller or an outside accountant, real ERP systems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, sometimes Microsoft Dynamics or Acumatica), and a layered financial life where the business and personal sides are deeply intertwined.

The owner pays themselves a distribution, then funds personal investments, then pays for an asset, then expenses something back through the company. Their accountant has to make all of it tie out. We are the only product positioned to make that integrated life elegant for both sides. This role builds it.
You will not build a generic accounting integration. You will build the Accountants Stack that bookkeepers, controllers, and CPAs actually want, which means knowing what they hate about QuickBooks, what they love about NetSuite, what they wish Bill.com did, and where the seams between business and personal finance create the most friction today.

----------------
Define the strategy and own the connectivity layer to the accounting and ERP systems our customers' accountants use. QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, etc.
Build expense management that works for owners and the accountants reconciling on their behalf. Receipt capture, GL coding, approval workflows, integration into the accounting tools without requiring manual reconciliation downstream.
Own bill pay and AR/AP. The workflow from invoice received to vendor paid, from invoice sent to customer paid, with full reconciliation back to the accounting system.
Build the invoicing product. We do not have a real invoicing offering today and customers are starting to ask. Decide what shape it takes and ship it.
Architect the connection between business financial data and personal financial data. This is the wedge no other fintech has. Make the integrated owner life real in product so the accountant can deliver it cleanly.
Partner closely with the Banking, Credit, Cards, and Payments product owners so financial flows tie out cleanly across the stack. No seams. No reconciliation tax for the accountant or the customer.
Translate the controller, CFO, and CPA persona for the rest of the company. We need someone who speaks both owner and accountant fluently. And can translate it to the owner mindset.
What you will need
------------------
You have spent years thinking about how business owners and the accountants who serve them actually run financial operations. You know the difference between a bookkeeper, a controller, a fractional CFO, and an outside accountant, and you have built product for at least one of them.
Deep, hands-on familiarity with at least two of: QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Acumatica. Not "I know they exist." Actually built in or integrated to them at depth.
You can journal a transaction without looking it up. You understand accrual versus cash basis, the close cycle, what a 1099 is for, and why a controller cares about the audit trail.
You have built either inside an accounting platform, on top of one as an integration partner, or built a fintech product that lives natively in the accounting workflow.
You understand the accountant channel and how CPAs influence product adoption. Bonus if you have built for or partnered with CPAs directly.
Typically 4 to 10 years of experience. Title is not the point.

Additional Information
We want to hear from you. We value passion, determination, and honesty. If you do not match every line of the spec but you can show us the work, apply anyway. Unusual paths and rare skills are how you stand out at Flex.

About Customer Portal
Customer Portal exists to make Veriff's product sell itself. The Portal serves two purposes. It allows our customers to operate Veriff products — setting up and configuring products, consulting verification session details, reporting issues.

And it is a privileged surface for customers to discover, try, buy and expand through a seamless self-serve experience, connecting product usage, onboarding and growth in one place. It unites forces with GTM to automate acquisition, upsell, cross-sell and retention, with end-to-end ownership of the customer persona. The area is evolving fast.

What began as a self-serve growth surface (Station) is becoming the customer-facing window into Veriff's accuracy and fraud advantage for our largest enterprise customers.
The shape of this role
This is an IC-first leadership role, and the first genuine step into product leadership — distinct from a strong senior IC. At first you will lead through craft, authority and influence. You own the strategy, discovery, roadmap and delivery for your product area.
As you refine the strategic themes for this large product, we expect you to propose the team configuration needed to support our growth and company objectives. That will move you progressively from IC to manager, while retaining hands-on ownership of at least one part of the Customer Portal area in the mid-term. We will deliberately assess for both the IC craft bar and the latent management capability, because the role is designed to traverse the line.

Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Customer Portal area, tied explicitly to Veriff's commercial model and revenue drivers.
Run disciplined, continuous discovery with customers, and translate it into well-defined problem statements and a sequenced roadmap.
Make transparent prioritisation and trade-off calls across product ambition, technical sustainability and business urgency — especially where capability gaps mean we cannot do everything at once.
Define success metrics before building, and hold the team accountable to outcomes, not output.
Partner as a credible peer to Engineering, GTM, Fraud Ops and Design. Be the connective tissue that turns internal expertise into a customer-facing product.
Own launch as a discipline from the start — internal platform releases and external GTM — not a milestone at the end.
Set and uphold the product-craft bar. Mentor PMs and, in time, build and lead the team.
Champion AI internally, implementing new best practices for faster product discovery and delivery.

You are a product leader who has earned authority through the quality of your thinking rather than a title.
You have owned a product area end-to-end
From strategy through discovery, delivery and launch. You are equally comfortable in the messy front end of a problem and in the discipline of shipping.
You are looking for the step where your impact starts to come through others, and you are excited that this role begins as an individual leader and grows into managing a team — not the other way around.
You think commercially
You instinctively connect what you build to how the business grows, and you explain the “why” behind a product bet in terms of revenue, retention and customer trust, not just features and flows.
You run discovery as a continuous discipline
You get close to customers, including demanding enterprise accounts, and you can tell the difference between what they ask for and what they actually need.
You turn that into sharp problem statements and a phased roadmap where every step delivers a real customer outcome.
You prioritise ruthlessly and transparently
When there are more good ideas than capacity, you make the hard calls about what not to do, and you can articulate the reasoning.
You define success before you build. When something goes wrong, you own it without deflection and change how you work as a result.
You lead through influence, not authority
You build credibility with engineering, go-to-market, design and operations partners as a genuine peer, and you reach good decisions with people who do not report to you.
You stay calm under uncertainty, create space for views that differ from your own, and commit gracefully once a call is made.
You raise the people around you
You set a high craft bar through your own work, share your thinking generously and give specific, useful feedback.
You are motivated by building and leading a team over time, with a realistic understanding that management is a different job — one focused on developing people and multiplying impact, not doing all the work yourself.
You stay current on your craft
You take pride in tracking how product management is evolving, and you consistently find time to experiment and fold what works into your practice.

Intégré(e) à une équipe de Transformation Digitale, vous interviendrez sur le périmètre Customer Service, notamment autour des activités liées aux réparations et à la gestion du stock.

Votre objectif : comprendre et challenger les besoins métier, proposer des solutions systèmes pragmatiques, les traduire en spécifications fonctionnelles et piloter leur réalisation jusqu-à leur mise en production et leur fonctionnement en Run.
Vous évoluerez dans un environnement applicatif comprenant notamment SAP CS, PLM, BI/Data ainsi que différentes applications métier.
## Responsabilités : ##
* Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins métier afin d-identifier les problématiques et opportunités d-amélioration.
* Identifier et proposer, avec les équipes IT, des solutions fonctionnelles et techniques adaptées.
* Traduire les besoins métier en spécifications fonctionnelles claires.
* Gérer et prioriser le backlog en collaboration avec les différentes parties prenantes.
* Piloter les projets et évolutions de bout en bout, de la définition du besoin jusqu-à la mise en production.
* Coordonner les équipes IT, métiers, experts techniques, intégrateurs et partenaires externes.
* Organiser les phases de tests et de validation métier, puis accompagner les déploiements et mises en production.
* Assurer le suivi post-déploiement et du Run, en veillant à la robustesse, la maintenabilité et la pérennité des solutions.
* Contribuer à l-amélioration continue des processus métier et à l-adoption des solutions par les utilisateurs.
## Ce que nous recherchons : ##
Vous disposez idéalement de 3 à 5 ans d-expérience en Product Ownership, gestion de projets IT, analyse fonctionnelle ou transformation digitale.

## Wir bewegen und begeistern Menschen. Einfach. Nachhaltig. Voraus. ##
Die **AMAG Leasing AG** betreut als Leasinggesellschaft gesamtschweizerisch die AMAG - Produktepalette, prozessiert und betreut die Leasingkundinnen und Leasingkunden aller Konzernmarken.
**Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der AMAG Leasing - im Team, mit Kundennähe und Raum für Entwicklung.**
Für unseren Bereich Change & Transformation suchen wir eine Person, die Freude daran hat, fachliche Ideen zu strukturieren, Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit Business, IT und agilen Teams wirksame Lösungen zu gestalten.
Du musst nicht jedes Kriterium zu 100 Prozent erfüllen. Wenn du Erfahrung in Produktarbeit, Business Analyse, agilen Methoden oder fachlicher Koordination mitbringst und Lust hast, dich weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
**Was dich bei uns erwartet**
Bei uns arbeitest du an Produkten und Prozessen, die für unsere Kundinnen, Kunden und Partner direkt spürbar sind. Du bringst Struktur in Ideen, übersetzt Bedürfnisse in verständliche Features und hilfst mit, dass unsere Produktentwicklung klar, kundenorientiert und umsetzbar bleibt.
Du bist Teil eines Umfelds, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Lernen und gegenseitige Unterstützung wichtig sind. Fachliche Führung bedeutet bei uns nicht -alles allein entscheiden-, sondern Orientierung geben, unterschiedliche Perspektiven verbinden und gemeinsam gute Lösungen ermöglichen.
## Wie wir dich begeistern ##
* **Flexibilität, die zum Leben passt**
Flexible und hybride Arbeitsformen gehören bei uns zum Alltag. So kannst du deine Arbeit möglichst gut mit deiner persönlichen Lebenssituation vereinbaren
* **Lernen und Entwicklung**
Wir unterstützen deine Weiterentwicklung, zum Beispiel durch passende Weiterbildungen, Zertifizierungen oder interne Lernmöglichkeiten
* **Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe**
Du arbeitest mit Menschen aus Business und IT zusammen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen wollen
* **Moderne Arbeitsumgebung**
Du nutzt unseren Projektspace am Hauptsitz und arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das Austausch und Kreativität unterstützt
* **Mobilität und Gesundheit**
Parkhaus, Car-Sharing, E-Bike-Flotte und kostenloses Fitnessstudio stehen dir zur Verfügung
## Was du bei uns bewegen kannst ##
* **Produktverständnis und Orientierung schaffen**
Du verstehst die Produktziele, bringst Kundenbedürfnisse ein und hilfst mit, Produktvision, Strategie und Roadmap verständlich zu machen
* **«Features» (Funktionalitäten) strukturieren**
Du formulierst und strukturierst sogenannte «Features» so, dass Business, IT und agile Teams ein gemeinsames Verständnis entwickeln
* **Backlog und Priorisierung begleiten**
Du pflegst das ART-Backlog inhaltlich, bereitest Themen für die PI-Planung vor und unterstützt die Priorisierung mit klaren Entscheidungsgrundlagen
* **Kunden- und Marktsicht einbringen**
Du nimmst Feedback von Kundinnen, Kunden, Nutzenden und Stakeholdern auf, analysierst Prozesse sowie Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab
* **Qualität und Wirkung sichtbar machen**
Du definierst gemeinsam mit relevanten Stakeholdern sinnvolle Kennzahlen und hilfst mit, funktionale und nicht-funktionale Anforderungen im Blick zu behalten
* **Zusammenarbeit im Agile Release Train fördern**
Du arbeitest eng mit Business Ownern, System Architects, Release Train Engineers, Product Ownern und Teams zusammen und förderst transparente Kommunikation im ART
## Das bringst du mit ##
**Das ist wichtig**
* Freude daran, komplexe Themen einfach zu erklären und gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern Lösungen zu entwickeln
* Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten sichtbar zu machen
* Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen, zum Beispiel Scrum, SAFe oder Kanban
* Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Product Ownership, Business Analyse, Requirements Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
**Das ist ein Plus**
* SAFe-Zertifizierung oder Interesse, dich im SAFe-Framework weiterzuentwickeln
Erfahrung mit Jira, Confluence oder Miro
* Grundverständnis von Softwareentwicklung oder IT-Architektur
* Erfahrung in fachlicher Führung oder Koordination von interdisziplinären Teams
* Erfahrung im Finanzierungs-, Leasing- oder Mobilitätsumfeld
Wenn du unsicher bist, ob du alle Punkte erfüllst: Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir prüfen gemeinsam, ob die Rolle und das Umfeld zu dir passen.
## Denkst du, dass wir zusammenpassen könnten? ##

Jedes KI-Tool. Neugier und Lernhunger sind Pflicht, Vollständigkeit nicht

About Schneider Geospatial
Schneider Geospatial is a leading PE-backed GovTech SaaS company transforming how governments serve their communities. Our GIS-based GovTech solutions power over 1,000 local governments across 34 states. We help public agencies streamline parcel management, permitting & licensing, and asset management, making government more transparent, efficient, and citizen focused.
Recognized multiple years as a Great Employer to Work For, we blend a purpose-driven mission with the innovation and agility of a high-growth software company. Schneider Geospatial has also been named GovTech 100 for four consecutive years, recognizing the most innovative and impactful companies serving the state and local government.
The Opportunity
We're seeking a Product Manager, Parcel Management, to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of one of Schneider Geospatial 's flagship product lines. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer (CPO), you'll partner with Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and customers to deliver innovative solutions that help local governments manage parcel data, support property assessment and taxation workflows, and provide reliable public access to property information.
You'll combine strategic product thinking with a deep curiosity for how assessors, auditors, treasurers, GIS teams, and other local government professionals work, translating complex parcel and property-data challenges into intuitive, scalable software that improves accuracy, efficiency, and transparency.
This is a unique opportunity to own a high-impact product in a PE-backed company entering an exciting phase of growth and modernization. You'll shape product strategy, influence customer outcomes, and help define the next generation of parcel management and public access solutions.

Mission + Impact: Build technology that helps local governments better serve citizens and businesses.
Ownership + Innovation: Lead a flagship product with meaningful ownership and strategic influence.
Growth + Learning: Partner with experienced product and executive leaders committed to mentorship and professional development.
Culture + Collaboration: Join a company recognized for its values-driven culture, collaborative environment, and relentless focus on customer success.
Compensation + Opportunity: Competitive salary, benefits, and clear pathways toward senior product leadership.

Product Strategy & Vision
Define and execute the product vision for Schneider Geospatial 's Parcel Management solutions.
Partner with the CPO and executive leadership to align product strategy with company objectives and market opportunities.
Translate customer feedback, market trends, evolving data standards, and competitive insights into a compelling product roadmap.
Identify and evaluate opportunities to apply AI, automation, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies to modernize parcel workflows, improve data quality, and create meaningful customer value.
Serve as the internal and external subject matter expert for parcel data management, property assessment and taxation workflows, GIS integration, and public property-information access.
Execution & Delivery
Collaborate closely with Engineering to translate product strategy into actionable user stories, features, and technical priorities.
Manage product backlogs and drive execution using Agile methodologies.
Partner with Customer Success and Implementation teams to ensure successful product adoption and measurable customer outcomes.
Develop data-driven business cases for new features and enhancements that improve data quality, customer outcomes, and business value.
Support Sales and Marketing through product demonstrations, competitive positioning, launch planning, and customer education.
Leverage AI-enabled tools, product analytics, customer insights, and experimentation to accelerate product discovery, improve decision-making, and continuously enhance the user experience.
Customer & Market Insight
Build strong relationships with customers to understand parcel-data workflows, operational challenges, statutory requirements, integration needs, and opportunities for innovation.
Monitor product performance, industry trends, data standards, legislation, and competitive offerings to inform ongoing product strategy.
Represent Schneider Geospatial at customer meetings, assessor and GIS conferences, user groups, and industry events as a trusted product leader.

Our Product Managers are both strategic and hands-on, comfortable defining long-term vision while diving into product details that create exceptional customer experiences. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, solving complex business problems, and building products customers genuinely love.
5+ years of product management experience, ideally within SaaS, GovTech, workflow automation, or business process software.
Experience with parcel management, property assessment or taxation, cadastral GIS, land records, public records access, or related local government technologies strongly preferred.
Proven ability to translate customer and data-workflow needs into product strategy, roadmaps, and feature prioritization.
Strong technical fluency and experience partnering with Engineering on modern SaaS products, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data architectures, and web applications; ability to engage credibly in technical tradeoff discussions without needing to be an engineer.
Familiarity with modern SaaS architectures (.NET, C#, JavaScript, SQL) and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
Understanding of modern web application frameworks (Angular, React) and user experience principles.
Strong analytical mindset with experience using customer, product, and data-quality metrics to drive product decisions.
Curiosity and practical fluency with AI and emerging technologies, with the ability to evaluate where new capabilities can meaningfully improve customer workflows, product experiences, and business outcomes.
Experience working with Agile teams and tools such as Jira.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Public Administration, GIS, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Your Future with Us
As Product Manager for Parcel Management, you'll shape the future of one of Schneider Geospatial 's most strategic product lines while helping local governments modernize parcel operations and make property information more accessible to their communities.
This role offers significant visibility across the executive team, opportunities to influence company-wide product strategy, and a clear path toward Senior Product Manager, Director of Product Management, or broader product leadership as Schneider Geospatial continues its growth.
Equal Opportunity
Schneider Geospatial is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and believe that diversity strengthens our team, fuels innovation, and drives success.

After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the intelligence layer for the construction industry.
The largest construction enterprises in Europe, with a combined project volume of over €30bn annually, rely on Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.
Construction has the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM, PDFs, drawings, 3D models, images, calculations. At Kuro you can tackle the hardest applied AI problems everyday.
Curious about the bigger product challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build .

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.
Kuro is the intelligent project data system for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible.
After one year on the market leading construction enterprises with a combined construction volume >30 billion annually use Kuro everyday to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions.
We are 16 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of ex-technical founders and builders that are ambitious and kind.
Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin
The Opportunity
As Product Manager , you'll work on the platform at the heart of Kuro's product, building the foundational capabilities that enable our teams to deliver faster and scale with confidence. You'll help defining the strategy and execution, from the data domain model, project graphs, and ontologies to workflow abstractions and essential services such as permissions, document versioning, lineage, and collaboration.
Working closely with the Co-Founder & CPO, platform engineering, design, and our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), you'll ensure every investment accelerates the development of future use cases, making the platform more extensible, scalable, and powerful with every release.

Be an active voice in roadmap creation, balancing immediate platform needs with long-term strategic investments.
Lead strategic initiatives to capture key decisions across the project lifecycle and evolve Kuro's scalable data domain model.
Define success metrics, use production data to iterate on platform capabilities, and communicate releases across the organization.
Make informed decisions on prioritization, scope, and sequencing, partnering with leadership on major architectural and new product bets.
Discover opportunities with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) and translate complex operational challenges into clear product requirements.
Your profile
5+ years of product management experience building technical products, such as AI, automation, developer tooling, or enterprise software.
Proven experience shipping data platform products, APIs, or graph- and ontology-based systems.
Strong understanding of how LLM-powered products behave in production and the challenges of building AI-native products.
Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and balancing short-term needs with long-term platform investments.
Passion for understanding users' day-to-day workflows and a willingness to become a domain expert in the construction industry.
Fluent in German, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

Familiarity with knowledge graphs, ontologies, or workflow abstraction frameworks.
Founder experience or experience building products in an early-stage startup.
Experience in construction technology (ConTech), AEC software, or a related industry.
Why Kuro
You are joining Kuro when it matters most. The product is live, our customers are using it daily, but their journey with Kuro has only started, and you can shape it from the get-go. There is no playbook, the world is changing at an unprecedented speed, and you can shape how one of the most critical industries around the globe wins in this new era.

Revenue Growth Management (RGM) is one of The Coca-Cola Company's most important commercial capabilities, and not simply a pricing discipline. Coca-Cola positions RGM alongside brand building, innovation, and integrated execution as a core capability for topline growth, and our growth strategy names it a key commercial capability for determining where to play and how to win.
RGM connects consumer demand to the economics of the system. It determines what we sell, in which packages, at what price points, through which channels and customers, and with what promotional investment, all in service of balanced growth across transactions, volume, and price/mix.

Done well, it finds incremental revenue pools and converts them into commercial action, improves the economics of every price, pack, assortment, and promotion decision, builds the affordability and premiumization ladders that bring more consumers into the portfolio, and gives Coca-Cola and its bottlers a common fact base for growing customer revenue and profit rather than simply negotiating price.
We are now reimagining RGM for the agentic AI era, and we are building it ourselves.

Our Global RGM Product is evolving from a suite of analytical solutions into an intelligent decision platform where AI agents interact directly with enterprise data, invoke advanced analytics and optimization models, run and compare scenarios, and hand commercial teams a recommendation with the reasoning attached.

Work that once took an analyst a week (pulling the data, running the model, writing the story, defending the number) is being compressed into a conversation.
Few companies are attempting this at this scale, and fewer are still against decisions this consequential: real pricing, promotion, and portfolio moves, made across markets and bottlers. The work sits at the frontier of the CPG industry, spanning agent orchestration, retrieval over enterprise data, and the evaluation of non-deterministic and deterministic systems, and none of it is a research exercise. What we build ships to commercial teams who use it to make decisions the same week.
This is an opportunity to build, not just design, the next generation of commercial decision intelligence at Coca-Cola, and to establish the operating model for agentic RGM at global scale. The patterns set here will shape how one of the world's largest commercial systems makes its most important decisions. If you want your work in front of real users, at real scale, from the first release, this is that role.

As Product Manager, RGM, you will own the what and the why of the Global RGM product: which problems it solves, for whom, in what order, and how success is measured. You will work within a persistent, cross-functional product team alongside Data Science, Engineering, UX, Architecture, and RGM experts. Engineering owns how the product is built; you own everything that determines whether it is worth building.
Product direction starts in market. You will spend time with RGM teams at operating units and bottlers to understand how pricing, promotion, and portfolio decisions are actually made, where current ways of working break down, and which problems are worth solving next. You will convert that discovery into direction: clear problem statements, a prioritized roadmap, and requirements that tell the team not just what to build, but why it matters commercially.
Day to day, this is a product ownership seat. You will write user stories and acceptance criteria, prioritize the backlog against commercial value, define what 'good' looks like for each release, and sign off that what shipped does what the business needed.

It demands genuine fluency in what the product produces (elasticities, uplift against baseline, share math) and in the commercial world those recommendations land in.

You will stay engaged across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and pilot design through launch, adoption measurement, and continuous improvement - because adoption is the truest test of whether you defined the right product.
The role is global across a commercial system that spans more than 200 countries and territories, roughly 200 bottling partners, and 30 million retail customer outlets - few products anywhere offer a larger canvas. It is also a first seat: the product discipline you establish here becomes the pattern for how the Global RGM Product scales to every market.

s.h: What You Will Do for Us
s.t:
Own the product roadmap for the Global RGM suite: define the problems worth solving, sequence capabilities by commercial value, and present the roadmap and the value delivered to OU leadership and bottler executives.
Run continuous discovery with users: sit with RGM managers and walk a run end to end (which price moves to take, which to skip, and why) to understand where the product creates value and where it falls short.
Translate discovery into direction: turn user pain into written requirements with clear problem statements, examples, and acceptance criteria, and retest with the same users once a fix ships.
Write user stories the engineering team can build against, and represent the voice of OUs and bottlers in prioritization and roadmap decisions with the Global RGM Product Owner.
Own and prioritize the product backlog against commercial value, with the judgment to say no, sequence competing requests, and defend a prioritization call to senior stakeholders.
Define the success measures for each release, participate in backlog refinement and sprint reviews with the pod, and give business sign-off that shipped functionality does what the market actually needed.
Guard the product's credibility by catching recommendations that would not survive scrutiny in front of a bottler, before the bottler sees them.
Embed the closed-loop RGM workflow in the product (insight generation and opportunity sizing, strategy setting, guardrail definition, in-market execution, and post-implementation evaluation) so markets operate a consistent, repeatable process.
Design for governance: make RGM rules of engagement (price floors and ceilings, discount depth and promotion frequency, and price-gap and price-index thresholds) capabilities the product enforces rather than policies applied around it.
Support pilot design and test-and-learn discipline with market teams: hypothesis framing, control groups, and incrementality measurement.
Partner with the AI engineer on insight quality, rating generated insights and flagging output the underlying data does not support.
Partner with the UX designer on launch communication, naming, and demo material so each release lands with the business.
Build the business case for significant capability requests: size the commercial opportunity, weigh it against effort and alternatives, and make the call on what is worth building.
Lead each release to adoption: launch planning, capability building, and short playbooks (how to read an elasticity, when to trust a recommendation), with the goal of users opening the product without you.
